name: Shakti lucid-dream series: sessions 1-5, temporal
origin: Todd Murphy, 8 Coil Shakti (pattern drawn from user reports)
summary: Sessions 1 to 5 of Murphy's lucid-dreaming series: the amygdala and hippocampal signals in sequence over both temporal lobes, once a week. Murphy says such temporal sessions are 'probably ... a prerequisite' for the frontal session 6, after which he reports cases of lucid dreaming 'that very night'.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed; relax without meditating or falling asleep. End the session 1 to 1.5 h before going to bed.
schedule: One session a week for 5 weeks, then session 6 (murphy-shakti-lucid-dream-series-frontal). Never on consecutive days; after the series take the vendor's 21-day break.
notes: 30 min on all 8 coils in the 8 Coil Shakti's 4-coil cross over each temporal lobe (front FT7/FT8, top C5/C6, back TP7/TP8, bottom T9/T10; the vendor gives the cross as a chart and photos without 10-10 names, so these sites are an inference). The Shakti's paired +/- coils and its channel alternation are not reproduced (no alternation setting is given for this session); all coils play the same signal together. Both signals are proprietary. The amygdala 'burstx' template is approximated by the built-in accelerating burst (6 to 30 Hz over 230 points, the point count of the published burst-firing pattern, drawn on the Shakti's 3-ms points = 0.69 s), the hippocampal 'LTP' template by 4 bursts of 4 biphasic pulses 9 ms apart repeated at 5.4 Hz (the vendor's reported LTP spectral peak), also on 3-ms points. As the vendor describes, the two follow each other with a 4-s silence after each: amygdala 0.69 s, silence 4 s, hippocampus 0.74 s, silence 4 s (a 9.4-s cycle). Murphy notes that 'There have not been many reports' of lucid dreams after the series, so do not expect it to produce them. The vendor also suggests an alternative dream session, chirp over both sides, then hippocampus over the right (murphy-shakti-lucid-dream-series-chirp-hipp). The vendor reports headache or pressure in about 2% of users with hippocampal signals; if so, lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop at once on fear or any distress. Independent double-blind tests found no effect of God-Helmet-type fields (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012).
